body.detail: Invalid page. Page 3 is past the end of the results: this request matches about 0.
body.resolution: The results ended before this page. Follow `next` until it is null instead of computing the last page from `count`, which can be an estimate. To walk a large result set, use cursor=: send an empty cursor= first, then follow `next`; it has no offset limit.
